subject: Create cross object from within R?

messages.author: 099c9ddaeadcd856
messages.subject: Create cross object from within R?
parts:
Hi,

I'm wondering if there's a way to create an R/qtl cross object from other R dataframes or objects. I have a script that processes a VCF file into something R/qtl can read, and it feels a little weird to have to write the dataframe to disk just to read it again with read.cross.

Could this be achieved in some way?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Create cross object from within R?
parts:
This is possible in principle, but we’ve not written any tool to do this, so at present your best bet is probably to just write to a file and re-read.

karl
